raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Reject Cohere Chat v2 requests that select `tool_choice="REQUIRED"` without a nonempty tools list, as required by the [Cohere specification](https://docs.cohere.com/reference/chat). Both chat and render endpoints now return a Cohere-shaped HTTP 400 before downstream processing.

## Claims

- Reject omitted, null and empty `tools` when tool choice is REQUIRED.
- Preserve valid required-tool requests and existing behavior for NONE or unspecified tool choice.

## Validation

```bash
VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE=cpu .venv/bin/python -m pytest \
  tests/entrypoints/cohere/test_protocol.py \
  tests/entrypoints/cohere/test_api_router.py \
  tests/entrypoints/cohere/test_serving_conversion.py \
  --confcutdir=tests/entrypoints/cohere -q

git diff --check
```

- **172 passed** on upstream base `9cede34a6`, including 7 new regression/compatibility scenarios.
- HTTP tests exercise the real routes, vLLM exception handlers and Cohere error-envelope middleware without an engine. They verify rejection before either handler is reached. Existing conversion tests cover valid REQUIRED requests with tools.
- Ruff lint and format checks passed for the three changed Python files; `git diff --check` passed. Existing Buildkite entrypoint jobs run the Cohere test directory.
- Validation runs on CPU without model weights and covers request parsing, HTTP error handling and conversion. No model-generation or accuracy evaluation was run.

## Details

The Cohere request model checks the tool-choice enum but lacks cross-field validation. Conversion constructs a shared `ChatCompletionRequest` before assigning tools and tool choice, bypassing its construction-time invariant. With no tools, rendering parameters then discard the requested tool choice. Add the check to the Cohere request model using the existing `VLLMValidationError` path.

Minimal baseline reproduction, without model weights:

```python
from vllm.entrypoints.cohere.protocol import CohereChatV2Request

CohereChatV2Request(
    model="m",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Use a tool."}],
    tool_choice="REQUIRED",
)
```

Upstream `9cede34a6` accepts this input, converts the choice to `"required"`, and then produces rendering parameters with `tool_choice=None`. This change raises `VLLMValidationError(parameter="tool_choice")` during request parsing. The same before/after behavior was verified for explicit null and empty tools.

Searches of open, closed and merged PRs on 2026-10-15 found no matching fix. Related [#52467](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/52467) standardizes existing validation errors, [#60309](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60309) maps handler exceptions to client error responses, and [#60586](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/60586) fixes JSON-schema forwarding; none adds this cross-field validation.

---

<details>
<summary> Pull Request Checklist </summary>

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.

- [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity.
- [x] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.
</details>

+        assert "tools" in body["message"]
